status: Expressions used in the native lab validated on 2026-10-15 and 2026-10-16. Create and verify them in your own project.
binding_policy: Use only exact schema columns and explicitly bound constants. Do not use externally managed bindings for this lab.

definitions.name: DQ V2 - Character length range
definitions.expression: IF value exists THEN len(value) >= minimum AND len(value) <= maximum

definitions.name: DQ V2 - Anchored format
definitions.expression: IF value exists THEN value matches_regex pattern

definitions.name: DQ V2 - Allowed client types
definitions.expression: IF value exists THEN value in_reference_list {'Individual','Corporate','Government','Non-Profit'}

definitions.name: DQ V2 - Allowed categories
definitions.expression: IF value exists THEN value in_reference_list {'Retail','SME','Enterprise','Institutional'}

definitions.name: DQ V2 - Allowed countries
definitions.expression: IF value exists THEN value in_reference_list {'US','FR','DE','GB','MA','ES','IT'}

definitions.name: DQ V2 - Unique identifier
definitions.expression: IF value exists THEN value unique

semantic_probes: out-of-scope clients are not evaluated by the condition
